registered_before: any Adult fit (frozen in SCIENCE_LOCK); executable: lra/select.py; tests lra/tests/test_select.py
rows: INNER_SELECTION only for metrics (attackers fitted on AUDIT_FIT); release identities on OSF_DEFENSE_FIT + AUDIT_FIT + INNER_SELECTION rows only; never assessment or HEAD_VALIDATION values

ordinary_eligibility.scope: EACH seed (0, 1, 2) and EACH task (income, occupation); no averaging across seeds; a candidate whose mean hides a failing seed does not qualify
rules: true-label log loss <= U log loss + 0.01 nats
accuracy gain over the OSF_DEFENSE_FIT-majority constant >= 0.8 x U's gain
exact decision preservation for U-derived releases
ordinary_eligibility.implementation: qpc.utility.gate_record(code, U anchor of the same seed, preserved)['eligible'] (inclusive)
ordinary_eligibility.applies_to: every candidate and comparator (codes, D1 decoders, continuous sources, references)

no_headroom_buffer: cbp's 0.006/0.0035 every-seed headroom rule is NOT used (prompt section 10). The explicit 0.005/0.003 budgets act during FITTING only; the unchanged assessment bounds decide whether confidence preservation is established

keys: mean over seeds of INNER pair AUC (lower first)
mean over seeds of summed true-label task log loss (lower first)
mean actual total token states (fewer first; continuous releases +infinity for ORDERING only, null in JSON)
ordering.tie_tolerance: keys 1 and 2: float64 seed mean (x_seed0 + x_seed1 + x_seed2)/3 in seed order, then Python round(x, 12); equal rounded values tie (values < 1e-12 apart may still fall either side of a rounding boundary); key 3 exact; key 4 lexicographic
ordering.token_states_rule: a code release must carry a finite positive integer token_states (alpha1 + alpha2) and a continuous release null; anything else is NON_ESTIMABLE_INNER_METRIC (technical, finding F06), never ordered as continuous

guard.rule: local inner AUC (recipient 1 and 2) <= guard comparator's local inner AUC + 0.005, inclusive, for EACH recipient and seed
guard.shortfall: exactly 0.0 iff the guard holds; otherwise max over guards, seeds, recipients of (a - g - 0.005)/0.005; ranking only

T*.note: strongest eligible privacy-UNTRAINED release: new C-TASK, D0/D1 DIRECT-TASK and FINE-TASK, U continuous, CLASS-ONLY (D0 and its registered D1 version U|CLASS|i1o1|D1, role F R-1), F0. RAW-J beta 0.3 is privacy-trained and excluded. If a CLASS variant is eligible and strongest it is T*; claim A can then pass only through finite-reader behaviour (every class-preserving release contains the class information), which is disclosed

P*.candidates: every privacy-trained release: D0 privacy maps (24), D1 fixed-map privacy controls (24), weighted controls (24), constrained arms (5)
P*.note: P* may be a control; if it wins it is delivered as the useful method and the new constrained search is reported as adding no demonstrated benefit. P* candidates are the 77 privacy-trained CODE arms (24 D0, 24 D1 fixed-map, 24 weighted, 5 constrained; lra.select.private_code). The privacy-trained references RAW-J, FARE and LEACE carry truthful metadata privacy_trained=true (training 'privacy-trained reference') but are NOT members of the registered code-only P*/C* pools (finding F05)

C*.candidates: incumbent/baseline private releases: D0 and D1 fixed-map privacy maps and weighted controls (72); NO constrained arm

C_pair*.candidates: every scored candidate except U|K-JOINT-PAIR|i8o64|D1 (incl. constrained LOCAL, both sequential arms, JOINT-SINGLE and every incumbent control, sources and references)

Q.eligibility: ordinary (prerequisite); otherwise NOT_ESTABLISHED_NO_ELIGIBLE_NOMINEE with P34-P37 DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY

privacy_trained_labels: fixed-map D1 privacy releases remain privacy-trained controls (their maps were privacy-trained); the D1 decoder itself uses no SEX. privacy_trained is truthful for every scored id: the 77 privacy-trained codes and the references RAW-J, FARE, LEACE are True; C-TASK, D0/D1 DIRECT-TASK / FINE-TASK / CLASS, U and F0 are False. Pool membership uses private_code (codes only)
global_configuration: one configuration fixed across all three seeds; no per-seed lambda or family; no assessment-based choice

nominee_roles: INVALID_NOMINEE (technical failure, no fallback; or an eligible nominee blocked only by a missing guard comparator, with its DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY fallback)

fallback_ordering.rule: when no candidate is nominable: fit-feasible candidates first (an infeasible constrained fit ranks last), then smallest ordinary shortfall, then smallest guard shortfall, then the ordering keys; DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY; never a pass
fallback_ordering.missing_guard: a required guard role without a valid nominee: INVALID (MISSING_GUARD_COMPARATOR) if any candidate is eligible, with the strongest eligible candidate by the ordering keys as its DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY fallback (fallback_rank_status INVALID_MISSING_GUARD_COMPARATOR; finding F04: the role keeps its place on the scored list); otherwise NO_ELIGIBLE with the fallback ranked on fit feasibility, the ordinary shortfall and the ordering keys only and fallback_rank_status INVALID_MISSING_GUARD_COMPARATOR (never a zero guard field)
fallback_ordering.technical: any candidate of the role with a technical failure (FIT_OR_ADMISSION_FAILURE, FIT_RECORD_TECHNICAL_FAILURE, DECISION_PRESERVATION_FAILURE, NON_ESTIMABLE_INNER_METRIC): INVALID, no fallback; the evaluation lock refuses until it is resolved (finding F13)
fallback_ordering.fallback_class_note: the four registered fallback kinds (prompt sec. 10): UTILITY (ordinary utility, or constrained fitting budgets under this registered decoder), LOCAL_GUARD, MISSING_COMPARATOR, TECHNICAL

aliases.identity: exact release aliases = byte-identical deployed release on all three seeds: sha256 over tok_i, q_i, hard_i restricted to OSF_DEFENSE_FIT + AUDIT_FIT + INNER_SELECTION rows (in that order, with their row-id hash) and the declared alphabets alpha_i (lra.select.release_identity). Assessment bytes never enter a release hash, an alias or a representative. Continuous releases alias by configuration ID only
aliases.not_aliases: a D1 fixed-map release shares tokens with its D0 map but not probabilities: NOT an alias; same tokens with a different decoder are never full-release aliases (finding F11)
aliases.canonical_equivalence: a release equal after renaming tokens by first occurrence on the permitted rows is recorded as canonical_equivalent / role_canonical_equivalence: informational, never an alias
aliases.every_role: alias sets are computed for EVERY role (P*, N*, J*, T*, C*, C_pair*, Q), comparators and Q included, on the role's nominee or fallback; role_aliases pairs two roles resolved to one configuration or to exact release aliases with different configuration IDs (findings F07, F11)
aliases.representative: one REAL member of the alias set names the family/construction: the members that belong to the role's OWN candidate pool (P*: the 77 privacy-trained codes; N*: the 5 constrained arms; J*: K-JOINT-PAIR; T*: the closed T* list; C*: the 72 incumbents; C_pair*: every candidate except K-JOINT-PAIR and infeasible constrained fits (exactly the pick pools); Q: Q) ranked by construction existing < calibrated < task-only < weighted < constrained, then family LOCAL < SEQ-12 = SEQ-21 < JOINT = JOINT-SINGLE < JOINT-PAIR, then configuration ID; decided_by_config_id_tiebreak is disclosed; the name is the representative's own (family; construction) (findings F02, F09)
aliases.identical_to_untrained: privacy-untrained exact aliases (C-TASK, D0/D1 DIRECT-TASK / FINE-TASK / CLASS) of P*, N* and J* are listed in identical_to_untrained, disclosed beside the role and in the label ('identical to privacy-untrained <ids>'); privacy training is never credited without a changed release (finding F03)

prespecified_diagnostics: best_d1_fixed_privacy: the strongest ordinarily eligible D1 fixed-map privacy control with the T* guard (or its fallback) and its paired D0 release
best_weighted_privacy: the strongest ordinarily eligible weighted control with the T* guard (or its fallback)

same_map_decoder_pairs: (best D1 fixed-map control, its D0 map), (P* nominee or fallback, its same-map D0 version: the D0 map itself for a D1 fixed-map P*, <cid>|D0SAME for a C-TASK / weighted / constrained P*; absent with a reason for a D0 P*), (C-TASK, U|C-TASK|i8o64|D1|D0SAME); d0same_targets lists the D1 maps whose D0 version is built by the d0same stage (label-free re-encode of the map's own token_proto; tokens bitwise equal)

display.training: rows carry a display field 'training': privacy-trained code / privacy-untrained code / privacy-trained reference (RAW-J, FARE, LEACE) / privacy-untrained reference (SRC|U, F0), and the truthful boolean privacy_trained plus the pool flag private_code; never role inputs beyond the registered pools

constrained_fit_feasibility: a constrained unit (K-*) is eligible only if its fit record has status FEASIBLE and deployed.feasible True on EVERY seed; a complete record that is not (status INFEASIBLE, or deployed.feasible False) is never a nominee for P*, N* or J*, is excluded from the C_pair* comparator pool, and gives the role reason CONSTRAINED_FIT_INFEASIBLE ('infeasible under this registered decoder') when no feasible candidate exists; it may still be the descriptive fallback (flag fit_feasible false). A fit unit that is missing or not hash-complete, an unreadable record, a status outside {FEASIBLE, INFEASIBLE}, a non-boolean or missing deployed.feasible, or a record naming another configuration or seed, on ANY seed, is a TECHNICAL failure (FIT_RECORD_TECHNICAL_FAILURE; fit_feasible null; the role is INVALID_*), never CONSTRAINED_FIT_INFEASIBLE (finding F01). Consequence (registered): K arms have no restoration phase, so if C-TASK violates a fitting budget on a seed, K-LOCAL (whose only start is C-TASK) is infeasible on that seed by construction
candidates_note: 89 per seed = 84 codes (27 D0, 27 D1 fixed-map incl. CLASS|D1, 30 new fits) + 2 sources + 3 references; 267 inner units
